notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 is live!
notes.content:
Hello again!

After some debugging, we're ready to release a small patch that hotfixes a couple of critical bugs and adds some small features that ease the starting steps into the game.


Go check the patch notes!

https://steamcommunity.com/app/1066230/discussions/0/3264459260622757383/

notes.title: Project Katharsis has been launched!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34912888/63deab0e6497dc843b1ab4904a61881561932037.png[/img]

Hey everyone, this is WiP Studios!

Yesterday, Project Katharsis was finally released, and we can't be happier. The data and feedback we're already getting is pretty good, we love that you're enjoying the game.

We're aware of most of the bugs and already working on them. Probably we'll upload a patch later today to fix the critical ones. We've also opened a bug thread on the forum so please, post all the errors and suggestions there.

If you have any questions about the game or the devs, check the F.A.Q. thread on the forum or contact us on [url=https://twitter.com/PKatharsis]@PKatharsis[/url] or via e-mail (katharsisgame@gmail.com).


Thanks a lot and enjoy!
